text: In 2010, the iPhone 4 had a beautiful steel band around the edge. That band was the antenna. It was split into sections by tiny gaps. Hold the phone so your hand covered the bottom-left gap, and your body joined the sections. Signal bars dropped. A customer emailed Steve Jobs about it. The reply: "Just avoid holding it in that way." Apple ended up giving out free rubber bumper cases, which kept your hand off the metal. Physics doesn't care how nice it looks.
